loginLead: Open your team workspace to follow incoming materials.
totpHelp: Enter the six-digit code if two-factor authentication is enabled.
loginFailed: Could not sign in. Check your credentials.
logoutAllWarning: You will be signed out of every device and ongoing uploads will be cancelled. Continue?
error: Could not load data. Please try again.
notFound: This material is not available within your account's scope.
offline: Connection lost. We will retry when it returns.
stale: Refresh failed. Showing the last successful update.
inboxLead: Follow incoming materials and their separate technical, editorial and rights states.
invalidFilters: Check the ID and dates you entered.
title: Material
pageSortNote: Sorting applies to this page only; the server sends pages newest first.
videoUnsupported: Your browser cannot play this video.
hiddenFields: Some data is hidden according to your account permissions.
formMissing: The form for this version is unavailable.
formLead: Explore the current upload form and try field validation. Values are not saved and files are not uploaded here.
datetimeHelp: Time is interpreted in your device's time zone.
attachmentHelp: Files are selected locally for validation only; nothing is uploaded.
locationUnavailable: Location fields are unavailable in this version.
unexpected: Could not open this page. Please try again.

validation.type: Enter a value of the correct type.
validation.pattern: The value does not match the required pattern.
validation.min: The value is below the minimum.
validation.accept: The file type is not accepted.
validation.max_size_bytes: The file exceeds the size limit.

review.title: Review actions
review.lead: Each action changes one state. Access and reservation ownership are checked when you submit.
review.reasonHelp: Do not include precise locations, device identifiers or protected source names.
review.changed: The material changed. Reload before trying again. Your edits have not been applied.
review.forbidden: This action is not allowed for your current account.
review.conflict: This action conflicts with the current state or another reservation. Reload and review.
review.versionMissing: Editing is unavailable until the current material revision can be read.
review.failed: The result could not be confirmed. Try the same action again to check it safely.
review.noTransitions: No state transitions are available for your account at this stage.
review.contributorsMissing: The contributor list is unavailable. Saving will replace the full list.
review.shareHelp: Saving replaces the full list. Use unique user IDs, up to two decimal places, and a total share of 100%.

admin.title: Account administration
admin.lead: Manage independent reading permissions, account access and reporter identity policy.
admin.targetHelp: Enter the exact user ID supplied by your administrator.
admin.grantWarning: Grant this permission to the selected account?
admin.revokeWarning: Revoke this permission from the selected account?
admin.suspendWarning: Suspending this account revokes its sessions and cancels ongoing uploads. Continue?
admin.activateWarning: Reactivate the selected account? Previous sessions will remain revoked.
admin.self: You cannot suspend your own account.
admin.statusHelp: The audit reason is the selected action: suspension or reactivation.
admin.reasonHelp: Do not include protected source names, precise locations or device identifiers.
admin.identityHelp: Choose which permission is required to read a reporter’s legal name. This setting applies to the whole organization.
admin.sourceAccessWarning: Anyone who already holds permission to read protected sources will be able to read reporters’ legal names.
admin.separateAccessHelp: Only accounts explicitly granted reporter identity access will be able to read reporters’ legal names.
admin.settingAudit: This change is recorded in the audit history and administrators are notified.
admin.historyHelp: Newest events first, including organization-wide identity policy changes. This history is not a list of current grants.
admin.selectHistoryUser: Enter a user ID, then load their history.
admin.historyMissing: The user or permission history is unavailable.

notice.title: Notifications
notice.lead: Read and acknowledge team updates without revealing protected information.

rules.title: Notification rules
rules.lead: Who is notified of which event, on which channel, and when unacknowledged work escalates. External channels carry the redacted payload only.
rules.denied: This page is for the system admin and editor in chief.
rules.readOnly: Read only; editing is for the system admin.
rules.confirmDelete: Delete this rule? Notifications it created remain.
rules.name: Administrative name
rules.assignment: The notification is a task that needs acknowledgement
rules.escalationHelp: Requires a task; levels are consecutive and delays increase.
rules.invalid: The rule is incomplete: a name, at least one recipient, a channel and increasing escalation delays.

store.previewUnavailable: Preview is not available right now.
store.exclusiveTaken: Exclusivity is not available for this material.
store.currencies: Currencies are not combined; each total is paid separately.
store.title: Catalog
store.lead: Materials for sale with a watermarked preview. Payment runs on a sandbox provider only.
store.denied: The catalog is open now to administration, rights, the editor in chief and finance; buyer accounts arrive with organizations.
store.notFound: This material is not for sale.
store.checkoutLater: Cart and hosted checkout arrive with the orders contract.
store.inCart: In your cart; go to it
store.buyersOnly: Buying is for buyer organization accounts.

board.title: Newsroom board
board.lead: Materials by editorial state, open urgent items and overdue acknowledgements. The snapshot refreshes every five seconds.
board.denied: This board is for supervisors, production and management.
board.uploadsUnavailable: Upload progress is not available from the server yet.

upload.title: Upload camera files
upload.lead: Choose large files from your computer or a camera card, then fill in the material details. Uploads resume from the last received part after a dropped connection.
upload.reporterOnly: Desktop upload is for reporters, supervisors, producers and the editor in chief.
upload.filesHelp: MOV, MXF, MP4, ProRes and camera stills. Each file's SHA-256 is computed in the browser before upload.
upload.pendingHelp: Choose the same file from your computer again to resume where it stopped.
upload.invalid: Check the required fields: a 5–80 character title, governorate, city and type.
upload.createFailed: Could not create the material. Try again with the same attempt.

phase.processing: Upload finished, awaiting verification and receipt

failure.session_revoked: Your session was revoked; the upload stopped.
failure.not_accepted: The upload session no longer accepts data.
failure.network: The connection dropped after several attempts.
failure.hash: Could not read the file to compute its checksum.
failure.checksum_mismatch: The checksum does not match what arrived; upload again.

upload.leaveWarning: An upload is in progress. Leaving stops it; you can resume by choosing the file again.
upload.abortFailed: Could not cancel the upload. Try again.
upload.otherDevice: Started on another device or its record here was cleared; it cannot resume from this browser.

mine.title: My materials
mine.lead: What you sent, its three states, and your supervisor's notes.
mine.firstPage: Only your latest 100 materials are shown; use the inbox to find older ones.
mine.uploadFailed: Upload failed; upload the file again from the material page.
mine.changesRequested: Your supervisor asked for changes; reply from the material page.
mine.empty: You have not sent any materials yet.
mine.openForNote: Open the material to read the note.

templates.title: License templates
templates.lead: Each license's terms and base price. Saving writes a new version; every sale keeps the version its buyer accepted.
templates.denied: This page is for the system admin, rights officer, editor in chief and finance.
templates.readOnly: Read only; editing is for the system admin and rights officer.
templates.newVersion: Saving writes a new version; the current one stays as is for past sales. The type cannot change.
templates.name: Name
templates.countryHelp: Two-letter codes such as PS, JO, QA, separated by commas.
templates.aiHelp: AI training is always prohibited unless separately permitted outside the template.
templates.commercialHelp: Offering this template on a material needs the system admin's approval in the listing.
templates.invalid: Complete the fields: name, terms and attribution in both languages, at least one medium and one deliverable, term and exclusivity for the type, and valid country codes.

formsAdmin.title: Form administration
formsAdmin.lead: Publish complete form versions and keep earlier versions readable.
formsAdmin.readOnly: You can read and preview versions. Only a system administrator can publish.
formsAdmin.empty: No version has been published yet.
formsAdmin.immutable: This is a new snapshot. Removing or reordering fields here does not change published versions or earlier materials.
formsAdmin.v0: Location is one of the ten supported types, but the current contract blocks location and sensitive fields until field encryption is available.
formsAdmin.searchHelp: Search candidate requests indexing review; it does not immediately create a search index.
formsAdmin.invalid: Check both languages, field keys, type-specific rules and condition references. Every key must be unique and every condition must reference another existing field.
formsAdmin.tooLarge: The form exceeds the web publishing limit of 64 KiB. Reduce its size before previewing.
formsAdmin.conflictHelp: A newer version may have been published. Your draft is still here. Discard and reload the current version before preparing a fresh publication.
formsAdmin.previewHelp: This is the same renderer used for materials. Values entered here stay in this preview and are never published or uploaded. Editing a field clears the preview and requires another review.
formsAdmin.publishWarning: Publish this snapshot as the current form? Published versions cannot be edited. Earlier materials keep their original form version.
formsAdmin.discardWarning: Discard all draft changes and reload the current published version?
formsAdmin.keyHelp: Start with a lowercase letter; use 2–64 lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
formsAdmin.typeHelp: Changing the type resets its validation rules and default value.
formsAdmin.label: Label
formsAdmin.conditionHelp: The controlling field must appear before this field and be visible for the selected material type.
formsAdmin.dateHelp: Use an ISO date with timezone, for example 2026-10-22T12:00:00Z.

listing.title: Catalog listing
listing.none: This material is not in the catalog.
listing.offersHelp: From enabled license templates, ten at most. Leave the price empty to use the template's.
listing.noTemplates: No enabled templates; create them on the license templates page.
listing.commercialAllowed: The material's contract allows commercial licensing
listing.commercialAdmin: Set by the system admin only.
listing.notSellable: Listing for sale requires the material's rights to be sellable.
listing.invalid: Complete the title and description in both languages and choose at least one offer.

buyers.title: Buyer organizations
buyers.lead: Organizations that buy from the store, their verification and seats. An organization cannot buy before it is active.
buyers.denied: This page is for the system admin and finance.
buyers.readOnly: Read only; creating and editing is for the system admin.
buyers.noOrganization: This account is not linked to an organization.
buyers.countryHelp: Two-letter code such as QA or JO.
buyers.firstAdminHelp: Their account is created as the organization admin.
buyers.adminOnly: Seats and status are set by the system admin.
buyers.pendingHelp: The organization is pending verification and cannot buy until it is active.
buyers.suspendedHelp: The organization is suspended: new purchases and downloads are stopped; earlier licenses remain.
buyers.invalid: Complete the legal name, the display name in both languages, a two-letter country code, a valid email and 1–1000 seats.
buyers.seatsFull: All seats are in use; ask the system admin for more.
buyers.inviteInvalid: Enter a valid email and choose a role.
buyers.inviteHelp: The invitation code is shown here once; the invitee sets a password with it and turns on two-step verification at first sign-in.
buyers.memberConflict: Could not change: the email is in use, the seats are full, or this is the organization's last active admin.
buyers.tokenOnce: This code is shown once and is not saved. Hand it to the invitee yourself outside the system; if it is lost, invite them again.
buyers.tokenMissing: The invitation was created, but the code is not shown because the request was repeated. If the invitee did not get it, invite them again.
buyers.done: I have handed it over; hide it

licenses.title: Licenses
licenses.lead: Licenses issued to your organization with their frozen terms, and licensed downloads.
licenses.denied: This page is for buyers, finance, the rights officer and the system admin.
licenses.preparing: The delivery package is being prepared; check back shortly.
licenses.downloadHelp: Every download is counted; the link is short-lived and never saved.
licenses.downloadConflict: Could not download: the limit is reached, the license is not active, or the package is not ready.

commission.title: Commission rules
commission.lead: The platform's share of each sale's net. The most specific rule applies: material, then reporter, then material type, then the default, and it is frozen into the sale's entry.
commission.denied: This page is for finance and system administrators.
commission.readOnly: View only: adding versions is for system administrators.
commission.shareHelp: Percent of net revenue after provider fees and tax; the rest goes to contributors by their shares.
commission.effectiveHelp: In your local time. Earlier sales keep what was frozen in them.
commission.appendOnly: Rules are never edited or deleted: saving adds a new version with its effective date.
commission.invalid: Complete the fields: a valid target for the scope, a share between 0 and {max}%, and an effective date.

orders.title: My orders
orders.lead: Your organization's orders and their status. Licenses are issued once payment is confirmed.
orders.cartLead: One line per material, in one currency. The price is fixed when the order is created.
orders.denied: This page is for buyers, finance and the system admin.
orders.sandbox: Sandbox payment: no real money. The payment page is the provider's; card details never pass through us.
orders.awaiting: You are back from the payment page. Waiting for the provider's confirmation; this can take a moment.
orders.paidHelp: The order is paid and the licenses are issued.
orders.expiredHelp: The payment window has passed; create a new order.
orders.conflict: Could not proceed: the price changed, the material is no longer listed, the exclusivity is held, or the order changed. Review the cart or the order.
orders.providerBlocked: The payment link is outside the allowed origins and was not opened.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.effect: Each refunded item's license is revoked at once and its download stops. The amount is the sum of the items' frozen prices; there is no free amount.
refunds.pendingHelp: A pending refund waits for the provider's signed confirmation.
refunds.nothingLeft: Every item is refunded or in a pending refund.
refunds.paidOnly: Only a paid order can be refunded.
refunds.conflict: Could not refund: the order changed state or an item was already refunded. Refresh the page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.temporary: Temporary text — the approved policy has not been published yet.
privacy.body: This page is a temporary structure for the privacy policy. Text approved by the coordinator will replace this notice. This text is not a complete privacy policy or consent to data processing.

earnings.title: My earnings
earnings.lead: Your share of each sale, computed from the ledger when you read it. Earnings stay pending through the refund window, then become available for payout after the reserve.
earnings.sandbox: Sandbox payout: no real money and no bank details. The sandbox channel completes a request once it is approved.
earnings.invalid: Enter an amount between the minimum and the requestable balance.
earnings.rejected: The server refused the request: below the minimum or above what is available after the reserve.
earnings.entriesLead: One line per entry that touched your earnings; the amount is your share alone, with no buyer or sale price.

payouts.title: Payout requests
payouts.lead: Contributors' requests, longest waiting first. Each approver approves once, and nobody approves their own request; above the policy threshold two approvers are needed.
payouts.denied: This page is for finance and system administrators.
payouts.ownRequest: Your request; someone else approves it.
payouts.conflict: Could not do that: the request changed state or you already approved it. Refresh the list.
payouts.policiesLead: Per currency: the minimum, the dual-approval threshold, and the reserve held from the available balance.
payouts.policyReadOnly: Adding versions is for system administrators.
payouts.appendOnly: Policies are never edited or deleted: saving adds a version with its effective date, and earlier requests keep their approval count.
payouts.invalid: Complete the fields: two non-negative amounts, a reserve between 0 and 50%, and an effective date.
